text:
Good question! 🌿

Yes, the duplicate-avoidance option is part of Plant Club, so it isn't tied to one plan. You can list up to **3 plants you already own**, and we'll try to avoid sending those.

- You can't choose the plant itself, since it's a surprise.
- The 3-plant limit is the same on Starter and Collector.

My knowledge base doesn't say whether your current list carries over automatically when you change plans. So after you upgrade, I'd check that your list of owned plants is still showing. If it isn't, just add it again. If you can't find it or something looks off, tell me and I'll escalate it to a Support Lead.

Since today is the 22nd, upgrading before the **25th** means the change applies to your next box.

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy planting! 🪴
